messages.subject: Mitogenome mapping with featureCounts
parts:
Hello Wei,

I've been using featureCounts on the Salmo salar nuclear genome without any issues. But I'm having trouble getting my S. salar mitogenome analysis running.

I've only got a few ESTs in 8 BAM files which I've mapped onto the mitogenome with the STARlong aligner.

featureCounts appears to be reading my annotation file properly (see below), but all of my ESTs are being assigned "Unmapped No Features" despite every base pair being annotated in some form. I have attached my annotation file, an example BAM file, and the featureCounts result files.   Thanks!

./featureCounts -a /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/subread
-1.5.0-p1/mitogenome_annotation_file.csv -A /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/subread-1.5.0-p1/mitogenome_alias_file.csv -F SAF -o EST_MT_hits_STAR.txt -R -T 8 -M -O /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/STAR-STAR_2.4.2a/bin/Linux_x86_64/ESTs_vs_MT/16K_MT_ESTs_alignAligned.out.bam /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/STAR-STAR_2.4.2a/bin/Linux_x86_64/ESTs_vs_MT/32K_MT_ESTs_alignAligned.out.bam /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/STAR-STAR_2.4.2a/bin/Linux_x86_64/ESTs_vs_MT/44K_MT_ESTs_alignAligned.out.bam /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/STAR-STAR_2.4.2a/bin/Linux_x86_64/ESTs_vs_MT/SIQ_MT_ESTs_alignAligned.out.bam /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/STAR-STAR_2.4.2a/bin/Linux_x86_64/ESTs_vs_MT/chinook_MT_ESTs_alignAligned.out.bam /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/STAR-STAR_2.4.2a/bin/Linux_x86_64/ESTs_vs_MT/TRAIT_v1_MT_ESTs_alignAligned.out.bam /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/STAR-STAR_2.4.2a/bin/Linux_x86_64/ESTs_vs_MT/TRAIT_v2.1_MT_ESTs_alignAligned.out.bam /media/genetics/Data1/Jeff_workstation_1/STAR-STAR_2.4.2a/bin/Linux_x86_64/ESTs_vs_MT/TRAIT_v2.2_MT_ESTs_alignAligned.out.bam

messages.subject: Re: Mitogenome mapping with featureCounts
parts:
Hi Jeff,

Your chromosome alias file is a tab-delimited file, which is of incorrect format. It should be a comma delimited file.

Cheers,
Wei
